title: How a Godly Man Apologizes Without Adding a But
caption:
A godly man apologizes without a “but.”

Name what you did. Drop the excuse. Go first even when it's mostly their fault, because Christ went first toward us. Then change the next Tuesday.

Who is one person you owe a clean apology this week?

#faith #godlymen #christianman #apology #humility #leadership
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
